title.zh: 其他内科：调神贯穿脏腑病，本虚标实分补泻，胃肠取足三里、中脘，背俞、刺络、灸随病加入
title.en: Other Internal Medicine: Regulating the Spirit Runs Through Organ Disease, Deficiency-Excess Decides Tonify or Reduce, Zusanli and Zhongwan for the Gut, Back-shu, Bleeding and Moxa Added by Disease

summary.zh: 内科杂病里他的做法有三条线。一是把“调神”带进脏腑病：呃逆、功能性胃肠病、神经性尿潴留都取内关、人中，称“调神通闭”“调神理气”。二是给常见病立自己的病机：高血压“气海失司”，治以“活血散风、疏肝健脾”；慢性气管炎与哮喘“本虚标实、以本虚为重”，用肺俞刺络拔罐配温肾运脾；糖尿病以肾为根本；痢疾“初痢宜通，久痢宜止”；便秘“腑气不通”；淋证初起忌补、后期兼补。三是脾胃病沿用足三里加中脘、天枢等合募配穴，慢病强调长期不间断。
summary.en: His internal-medicine practice runs on three lines. First, regulating the spirit is carried into organ disease: hiccup, functional gastrointestinal disease and neurogenic urinary retention all take Neiguan and Renzhong ("regulate the spirit, open the blockage", "regulate the spirit, rectify qi"). Second, common diseases get his own mechanism: hypertension "qi sea out of control", treated by "activating blood, dispersing wind, soothing the liver, strengthening the spleen"; chronic bronchitis and asthma "root deficiency, branch excess, deficiency predominant", with bleeding-cupping at Feishu plus warming the kidney; diabetes rooted in the kidney; dysentery "open at first, astringe when chronic"; constipation "fu qi blocked"; strangury contraindicating tonification at first, adding it later. Third, gastric disease keeps Zusanli with Zhongwan, Tianshu and other he-mu pairings, and chronic disease is treated without interruption.

takeaways.zh: “调神”是他带进内科的固定手法：呃逆“重在以醒脑调神之法，关键在于手法及施术的量学要求”，取内关、人中“醒脑调神，镇静止呃”，另加膈俞刺络拔罐、膈俞麦粒灸和咽后壁点刺；功能性胃肠病(恶心呕吐)“在调神的基础上加以配方”，内关调神镇静，足三里、天枢、上巨虚调脾胃；神经性尿潴留治则“调神通闭、利尿”，他强调“不能仅仅着眼于膀胱”。
takeaways.en: "Regulating the spirit" is the constant he brings into internal medicine. Hiccup: "the emphasis is on awakening the brain and regulating the spirit, the key is the quantified requirements of manipulation"; Neiguan and Renzhong "awaken the brain, regulate the spirit, calm hiccup", plus bleeding-cupping and grain-size moxa at Geshu and pricking of the posterior pharyngeal wall. Functional gastrointestinal disease (nausea, vomiting): "formulas are built on regulating the spirit", Neiguan regulating and calming, Zusanli, Tianshu, Shangjuxu regulating spleen and stomach. Neurogenic urinary retention: principle "regulate the spirit, open the blockage, promote urination", and he stresses one must "not look only at the bladder".

takeaways.zh: 高血压有他自己的病机：据“气海学说”首次提出病机为“气海失司”，治则“活血散风、疏肝健脾”，主穴人迎、曲池、合谷、足三里、太冲，再按肝阳上亢、肝风内动、痰湿中阻、瘀血阻滞、肝气郁结、阴虚阳亢、肝肾阴虚、阴阳两虚八证加穴。预后一句写明：针刺配合药物，减轻头晕、平稳降压，长期可减少合并用药。
takeaways.en: Hypertension has his own mechanism: on the "qi sea" theory he was first to put the mechanism as "qi sea out of control", principle "activate blood, disperse wind, soothe the liver, strengthen the spleen"; main points Renying, Quchi, Hegu, Zusanli, Taichong, with additions for eight patterns (liver yang rising, liver wind stirring, phlegm-damp, blood stasis, liver qi stagnation, yin deficiency with yang hyperactivity, liver-kidney yin deficiency, yin-yang deficiency). Prognosis stated plainly: needling with drugs eases dizziness, steadies pressure, and long-term use can reduce co-medication.

takeaways.zh: 心系病取补法与调神并用：心悸以“益心气、养心血”为大法，取心包经原穴大陵与心经原穴神门补之，加内关、厥阴俞、心俞、膈俞；8例心悸医案中内关8、神门7、厥阴俞7、心俞7、膈俞7。胸痹(真心痛)病机“心气不足，胸阳不振，推动无力，血行不畅”，发作时“急则治其标”，先止痛；虚补实泻按阴虚、阳虚、气滞、血瘀、痰浊加穴。
takeaways.en: Heart disease combines tonification with regulating the spirit. Palpitation: "boost heart qi, nourish heart blood" as the main method, tonifying the pericardium source Daling and the heart source Shenmen, plus Neiguan, Jueyinshu, Xinshu, Geshu; in 8 palpitation cases Neiguan appears 8 times, Shenmen 7, Jueyinshu 7, Xinshu 7, Geshu 7. Chest bi (true heart pain): mechanism "heart qi insufficient, chest yang not stirring, propulsion weak, blood flow not smooth"; during an attack "treat the branch when urgent", relieve pain first; then add points by yin deficiency, yang deficiency, qi stagnation, blood stasis, phlegm.

takeaways.zh: 肺病一律“本虚标实、以本虚为重”：慢性气管炎立“温肾运脾、宣肺疏邪”，哮喘“着重扶阳固本，扶正祛邪”；特色是肺俞刺络拔罐(“独到之处”)，哮喘另用华佗夹脊(2、3、5、7对)刺络和肺俞、风门、厥阴俞温灸，再取尺泽、天突、太溪、足三里、肾俞固本。预后不夸大：哮喘“尚不能根治”，针刺重在即刻缓解与缓解期预防。
takeaways.en: Lung disease is uniformly "root deficiency, branch excess, root predominant". Chronic bronchitis: "warm the kidney, move the spleen, diffuse the lung, dispel evil"; asthma: "stress supporting yang and securing the root, supporting the right to expel evil". His signature is bleeding-cupping at Feishu ("the unique point"); asthma adds bleeding at Huatuojiaji (pairs 2, 3, 5, 7) and moxa at Feishu, Fengmen, Jueyinshu, with Chize, Tiantu, Taixi, Zusanli, Shenshu to secure the root. Prognosis is not inflated: asthma "cannot yet be radically cured", needling serves immediate relief and prevention in remission.

takeaways.zh: 脾胃肠病的骨架是足三里：胃肠类75例医案中33例(胃脘痛、呕吐、泄泻、便秘)，足三里占22例；慢性胃炎“以健脾养胃、化瘀止痛为主”，胃下垂“升举中气”并强调腹肌锻炼；泄泻/痢疾提炼为“初痢宜通，久痢宜止，通以清热利湿为先，止以培固脾土为本，然通腑除滞贯彻始终”，并对各型泄泻通用拔罐、灸足三里、关元、天枢；便秘的关键是“腑气不通”，主穴丰隆加左侧水道、归来一组，体虚老年者温灸神阙、气海、关元。
takeaways.en: The gut frame is Zusanli: of the 75 organ-disease cases, 33 are gastrointestinal (stomach pain, vomiting, diarrhoea, constipation) and Zusanli is in 22. Chronic gastritis: "mainly strengthen the spleen, nourish the stomach, resolve stasis, relieve pain"; gastroptosis: "lift the middle qi", with abdominal-muscle exercise. Diarrhoea/dysentery is condensed as "open at first, astringe when chronic; open by clearing heat and draining damp first, astringe by securing the spleen earth, while moving fu-organs and clearing stagnation runs throughout", with cupping for all types and grain-size moxa at Zusanli, Guanyuan, Tianshu. Constipation: the key is "fu qi blocked", main points Fenglong with the left-sided Shuidao, Guilai group; warm moxa at Shenque, Qihai, Guanyuan for the old and weak.

takeaways.zh: 糖尿病以肾为根本：“注重肾虚发病为主的理论，制订调节肾之阴阳为主、调整五脏为辅的治疗方案”，“脏腑阴亏为本，燥热为标”；分阴虚内热(益阴泻热：脾俞、肾俞、足三里、曲池、太溪、列缺、照海、胰俞)与气虚阳衰(温阳益气：气海、中脘、足三里、尺泽、三阴交)两型，并配耳针。要求长期：首月“不可间断治疗”，共1~2个月，稳定期3~6个月。
takeaways.en: Diabetes is rooted in the kidney: "stress kidney deficiency as the chief cause, with a plan of regulating kidney yin and yang mainly and the other five zang secondarily"; "yin depletion of the zang-fu is the root, dryness-heat the branch". Two types: yin deficiency with internal heat (boost yin, drain heat: Pishu, Shenshu, Zusanli, Quchi, Taixi, Lieque, Zhaohai, Yishu) and qi deficiency with yang decline (warm yang, boost qi: Qihai, Zhongwan, Zusanli, Chize, Sanyinjiao), with auricular therapy added. Long treatment is required: no interruption in the first month, 1-2 months in all, 3-6 months in the stable stage.

takeaways.zh: 泌尿病有“先泻后补”的边界：淋证“初起多为实热，治宜通利，忌用补法；后期多虚或虚中夹实，治宜兼用补法”，主穴膀胱俞、肾俞、三焦俞、中极、秩边透水道，排尿困难者加气海、关元，针后加灸；神经性尿潴留则不同，从“神不导气”入手，取内关、人中加秩边透水道、中极、关元。
takeaways.en: Urinary disease has a "reduce first, tonify later" boundary. Strangury: "in the early stage mostly excess heat, promote flow, do not tonify; later mostly deficient or mixed, tonify as well"; main points Pangguangshu, Shenshu, Sanjiaoshu, Zhongji, Zhibian through to Shuidao, with Qihai and Guanyuan plus moxa for difficult voiding. Neurogenic retention is treated differently, from "spirit failing to guide qi": Neiguan and Renzhong with Zhibian through Shuidao, Zhongji, Guanyuan.

caveats.zh: 胸痹一条(实用针灸学)主穴中两穴原文OCR残损(“门”“腹中”，疑为郄门、膻中)，本指南只引未残损者，并在表中注明。哮喘、咳嗽、高血压等的病名与病理沿用现代医学，机理陈述(气海学说、针刺对排尿中枢的作用等)是院士团队的解释，非古法通例。医案计数为本指南对已结构化医案的统计，各病例数很小(咳嗽3例、糖尿病3例)，只可看作倾向。
caveats.en: In the chest-bi entry (practical text) two of the main points are OCR-damaged ("men", "fuzhong", probably Ximen and Danzhong); the guide cites only the intact ones and says so in the table. Disease names and pathology for asthma, cough, hypertension and others follow modern medicine, and mechanistic statements (qi-sea theory, action on the micturition centre) are the explanations of his team, not classical common ground. Case counts are this guide's tallies of the structured cases; several diseases have very few cases (cough 3, diabetes 3), so they show tendency only.
